notes: The football database is versioned independently from SWOS Studio.
The published squad model separates Full Modern Squad, Installed SWOS 16 and Club Squad Pool.
The first five existing 16-player research packs are published outside the main app bundle as an independent data resource.
The ten identity-ready Premier League clubs are now published through a separate verified identity feed, including current shirt/role/nationality evidence and separately held U21 candidates.
The live Research Pack loader can consume the independent feed with an embedded safety fallback.
Every preview build validates manifest totals, pack sizes, identity coverage, SWOS positions, core player fields, schema constraints, career isolation and binary-write locks before publication.
TEAM.* installation remains disabled until the full dataset and write safety gate are ready.
Existing career files are never automatically updated from the real-world database.
